bluf: RYNO Strategic Solutions is a PE backed home services agency, founded 2008 and owned by EverService Holdings, that sells websites, SEO, AI SEO, paid media, Local Services Ads and CSR call coaching to local trades contractors. It merged with sister agency Blue Corona in 2024-10 but kept its brand, and its Google ads now run under the Blue Corona, LLC account: 40 in the Transparency Center, 30 in the last 30 days. Its blog is turning toward AI search for contractors. What a rival should know: the record shows AI search content but no audited AI visibility product, and a Monsoon displacement read of 70.8.
doing:
The positioning line, "Digital marketing for the trades: websites, SEO and AI SEO, paid media, Local Services Ads, CTV and CSR call coaching for home service contractors," decodes to a full lead engine for contractors that also trains the staff who answer the phone. The headline claim, that it pitches marketing "for the trades since 2008, with call coaching on every call and transparent reporting," rests on tenure and on a call handling layer, CSR Coaching and Call Intelligence, sold beside the media.

No single line leads: the capability read scores every core line at 2. SEO rests on a service page and a 428 URL contractor marketing blog with 42 URLs updated in the past year; Web & Product on a website design page that leads the prior search service list; Paid Search on paid media and LSA pages and 40 Google ads; Local on a Local Services Ads page (P3 making); Data & Measurement on call intelligence and RYNOtrax 2.0, its only proprietary product, seen only as a service slug; AI Search / GEO on an AI SEO service and blog posts. The only partner listed is the ServiceTitan Marketplace; its own announcement cites a MarTech Outlook 2022 Top 10 listing.

AI posture: it sells AI SEO and writes about AI search for contractors, with posts dated 2026-05-14 (Ask Maps), 2026-06-23 (agentic AI search) and 2026-09-08 (query fan out), but no AI tooling or automation offer shows and AI Automation / Agents scores 0.

Its Lever board lists 4 openings, paid media roles among them. The record lists no pricing. Conspicuously absent: an office, a headcount, any case study of its own newer than 2023-08-09, and a readable homepage.

The record types the client base as local and lists trades verticals: Roofing, Restoration, Electrical, Plumbing, Pest Control, Franchises, Garage Doors, Solar and HVAC. No office is listed, so the home market is the US by region only.

Three clients are named, all through case studies: one observed and two names only. Black-Haak is the observed engagement: its case study, dated 2023-08-09 and last modified 2026-08-25, says RYNO helped it "grow website traffic by 200%+ and cut cost per lead by 70%+ with SEO and paid media strategies," which the needs read codes paid performance, organic demand and local and lead generation. Both also sit on the blue-corona book, the two shared clients the record lists, so the merger left the same contractors on the RYNO and blue-corona books and the record cannot say which brand serves them.

openings:
The strongest opening is AI visibility as a product. It sells AI SEO and has published AI search posts for contractors through 2026-09-08, yet the record shows no audited AI visibility product (P1 partial) and no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent). A rival that shows a roofer or plumber a local AI visibility scorecard will likely win the contractor who asks whether assistants recommend them (moderate confidence). Falsifier: an AI visibility tracking or citation share offer on its service pages or in its ads at the next compile.

Second, the proof is old and borrowed: one own case study, Black-Haak, dated 2023-08-09, and two named clients carried on Blue Corona pages. A rival with dated results in the same trades is likely to win the proof contest (moderate confidence), and Penguin Air, Plumbing & Electrical and GAC Services are a roughly even chance to be contestable while the merged brands share them. Third, displacement reads 70.8 on a local book, so an offshore delivered rival can likely undercut SEO and web build hours, though call coaching is harder to price against. The computed idle publishing opening is unlikely to hold given the deepen read's 2026-09-08 blog date.
